computed.method: Polygons returned with outSR=4326; union and centroid computed in EPSG:26914 (NAD83 / UTM 14N) and returned to WGS84 (EPSG:32614 cross-check gives the same point); geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid. The condominium unit polygons overlap, so the union (5.95 acres) is smaller than the sum of the unit acreages

identity_bridge: TierPoint's page gives 'Omaha - Bellevue (BEL) 1001 North Fort Crook Road Bellevue, NE 68005' for a 100,000+ square-foot data center and colocation facility.

A Sarpy County parcel query for site addresses beginning '1001 FORT CROOK RD N' returns the three units of the Southroads Technology Park Condominium Regime and one improvements-only bank parcel on Lot 3; the condominium units together form the multi-tenant building property at that address.
TierPoint's own structured-data point (41.177323, -95.924737) lies inside the union (inside units 4 and 1/3/5/6), 83.7 m from the selected centroid; it is a cross-check only.
unresolved: Which condominium unit holds TierPoint's data-centre space is not published; the other units are recorded as charitable-organisation property, so the point locates the host building property, not the data-centre suite.
The county layer is a December 2023 snapshot; the building and its condominium regime predate it.
